title: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
one_line_judgement: 今天值得试：据摘要（arXiv 2610.20597）：Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language …
one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.20597）：Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents 把 language agent RL 的'长 horizon rollout cost 高 / 中间步骤监督浪费 / value target（per-step success probability）难构造 / observation target（fit environment response）难构造'拉到'co-evolving acting and forecasting：用一个 forecast head 提供 intermediate supervision / 不依赖手工 value 或 observation target / 提升 sample efficiency'。是 ai-agent × llm-evaluation × inference-serving 的 'co-evolving acting-and-forecasting agentic RL' 即时资产——'forecast head as intermediate supervision' 范式可迁移到任何 'agentic RL sample efficiency / intermediate-supervision agent / long-horizon agent training' 子方向（coding agent RL sample efficiency、tool-use RL intermediate supervision、agentic workflow RL），与 aiutil 长期关注的 ai-agent × llm-evaluation 主线在 'agentic RL co-evolving supervision' 层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无（仅 PDF / arXiv），需打开 PDF 看 forecast head 形式化（参数共享 / 损失设计）、acting head 与 forecast head 共训练稳定性、跨 long-horizon task 验证、与 value-target / observation-target baseline 对照、是否开源 Co-Evolving pipeline。今日新即时路线资产卡片：写 'co-evolving acting-and-forecasting agentic RL' checklist 草稿。
